**Lectura de datos**
```{r}
if(!require("readxl")){
install.packages("readxl")
library("readxl")
} else {
library("readxl")
}
datos <- read_excel("BaseVersion1.xlsx")
head(datos)
```

**Cargar Paquetes**
```{r}
if(!require("BSDA")){
install.packages("BSDA")
library("BSDA")
} else {
library("BSDA")
}

```

**Pregunta 1**
```{r}
mean(datos$HorasRedes)

```

**Pregunta 3**
```{r}
x <- length(which(datos$Opinión == 1))
n <- nrow(datos)
prop.test(x, n, conf.level = 0.97)$conf.int

```

**Pregunta 4**
```{r}

x <- length(which(datos$Opinión == 0))
n <- nrow(datos)
prop.test(x, n, p=0.55, alternative = "two.sided", conf.level = 0.98)
```
